Taimanin, known as Anti-demon ninjas, are ninjas which are able to use Taima Particles to fight for justice.

Can address individual or multiple Taimanin. They are a combined force of different ninja clans which united. Taimanin are separate from any government but work cooperate when necessary. As an organization, they perform investigations, infiltration, rescues and elimination of demons or dangerous groups for justice. Their main headquarters is Gosha, Village in Kanto Japan and have a global population of roughly 13,000 members.

They take on difficult missions because of their training, supernatural abilities, and advanced technology.
